title: Orange Jordan and Ericsson complete landmark digital billing transformation
summary: Orange Jordan and Ericsson have successfully completed a landmark Business Support Systems (BSS) transformation, migrating to a new-generation Ericsson Billing. The complex cutover and go-live were finalized ahead of schedule with minimal business disruption, showcasing execution excellence. The modern monetization platform provides a future-ready foundation for Orange Jordan to accelerate innovation and capture new revenue opportunities in 5G and IoT.
body_markdown:
- Orange Jordan and Ericsson have successfully completed a landmark Business Support Systems (BSS) transformation, migrating to a new-generation Ericsson Billing.
- The complex cutover and go-live were finalized ahead of schedule with minimal business disruption, showcasing execution excellence.
- The modern monetization platform provides a future-ready foundation for Orange Jordan to accelerate innovation and capture new revenue opportunities in 5G and IoT.
